required_boundary: Representation target + typed versioned selector bundle + optional state anchor
mistake_avoided: Avoid brittle page/offset-only citations and source mutation.

required_boundary: Separate logical document, acquired bytes and derived representations; identifiers are not filenames/numbers
mistake_avoided: Avoid identity collapse when files are replaced, transformed or renamed.

required_boundary: Record each observation separately from URI and payload; same bytes may recur
mistake_avoided: Avoid treating URL or absence in one crawl as source truth.

required_boundary: Preserve raw mention/source identifiers; reconciliation is later and reversible with merge/split lineage
mistake_avoided: Avoid false identity merges and irreversible normalization.

required_boundary: Permit contradictory sourced claims; provenance/review/assessment remain separate dimensions
Store direct semantic edges only; promote rich role/time/amount relations to typed association/event
mistake_avoided: Avoid generic nodes/edges and n-ary relation explosion.

required_boundary: FK/PRAGMA bootstrap, local attached storage, one writer path, short transactions, minimum version floor
mistake_avoided: Avoid silent FK-off writes, network-filesystem corruption and concurrency surprises.
Avoid search index becoming evidence authority.

required_boundary: Consistent DB snapshot + originals + non-regenerable state; derived indexes/caches classified explicitly; purge/retention scope of historical backups named
mistake_avoided: Avoid stale live-file copy, incomplete backup, and false purge claims while old backup copies remain in scope.

required_boundary: Outputs read/query via bounded contracts; arbitrary SQL/filesystem/network access is not implicit
mistake_avoided: Avoid plugin bypass of permissions and SSRF/path exfiltration.

required_boundary: Generic acquisition can degrade; specialized parser must fail loudly on unexpected structure and record tool/profile version
mistake_avoided: Avoid plausible but semantically wrong structured data.

required_boundary: Immutable-by-default; redaction is derivative; purge exceptional and explicit with permissible tombstone/lineage plus SQLite/FTS/archive scrubbing semantics
mistake_avoided: Avoid impossible eternal-retention promises, silent destructive edits, or equating logical DELETE with forensic erasure.

required_boundary: Universal core small; local document profiles/tags versioned and validated; direct taxonomy edges only
mistake_avoided: Avoid national closed ontology and arbitrary JSON payloads.

required_boundary: Batch/supervised UX applies attributable per-record outcomes; validator/reconciliation result is not truth
mistake_avoided: Avoid click-per-claim bureaucracy or opaque batch authority.
